title: Record kill-switch stops as killed; mark bound-only cost provisional
summary: Fix m8: when the kill switch stops a producer before the driver's check, record the invocation as killed rather than error. Mark the cost_usd quantity score provisional when execution cost is only a bound. Audience is the maintainer and verifier reading records and scores.

defaults_applied.how: New tests in agent, score, and cli crates; clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria run tests that exercise killed and provisional outcomes.
Fix the attribution in the driver and the scoring of bound costs, not one record.
Docs and changelog updated for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: fix minor m8 of the v0 acceptance review; audience is the maintainer and verifier reading invocation records and scores.
Exact file paths in athena-score and athena-core are inferred; the producer locates them.
No governance files need to change.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new driver test in crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs shows a child ending with no result while the kill switch is on yields InvocationOutcome::Killed with a detail naming the kill switch, not Error. Run: cargo test -p athena-agent.

A new scoring test in crates/athena-score builds a job whose execution cost is only a bound and shows the cost_usd quantity score is provisional; a job with exact costs is not provisional. Run: cargo test -p athena-score.

An end-to-end test in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs shows a producer stopped by the kill switch closes with a killed invocation record and a provisional cost score, and the commit gate accepts the recomputed score. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli.
Whole workspace passes cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets with no warnings; cargo fmt --check is clean.
A bound-only cost is no longer scored as a firm figure, and a provisional cost_usd score does not count in aggregates as a resolved value.
Older score.json records without the new field still deserialize (serde default); existing history tests still pass.
docs/records.md describes the provisional quantity field and kill-switch attribution, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry citing m8 of docs/design/reviews/athena-v0-acceptance-1.md.
